annotation.title_clean: 自動運転の実証実験に係る基準緩和認定制度(遠隔型自動運転・歩行型ロボット等)申請ガイド
annotation.title_en: Standards Relaxation Certification System for Automated Driving Demonstration Tests (Remote-type Automated Driving, Walking-type Robots, etc.) – Application Guide
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (MLIT), Japan
annotation.summary_en: MLIT application guide for Japan's standards-relaxation certification system for automated driving demonstration tests, covering remote-type automated driving and walking-type delivery robots treated as Class 1 motorized bicycles. It explains application documents, safety-standard compliance, alternative safety measures, and regional contact offices.
key_provisions_or_claims: Since Feb 2017, demonstration vehicles may be exempted from safety standards other than emissions/noise if alternative safety measures are taken.
April 2020: relaxation system extended to motorized bicycles for automated driving trials.
Walking-type robots at 6 km/h or below are treated as Class 1 motorized bicycles.
Applicants must submit forms, safety-standard conformity review results and alternative safety measures.
